title: Watch Patrol Coverage Gap
dataSources: Nextdoor posts (`nextdoor:post`), Ring Neighbors alerts (`ring:neighbor`), neighborhood watch logs (`neighborhood:watch`), and local alerts (`local:alert`).
app: Nextdoor post exports, Ring Neighbors alerts, neighborhood watch logs, and local emergency alert feeds ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=neighborhood:watch patrol_zone=* patrol_minutes=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(patrol_minutes) as weekly_minutes by _time patrol_zone
| where weekly_minutes<30
| sort _time patrol_zone
description: Lists patrol zones with fewer than thirty logged neighborhood watch minutes in a week.
value: Coverage gaps leave blind spots on blocks that rely on volunteer patrol visibility for deterrence.
implementation: Log patrol sessions with `patrol_zone` and `patrol_minutes` and review under-covered zones weekly.
visualization: Heat map of weekly patrol minutes by zone.
grandmaExplanation: It spots parts of the neighborhood that did not get enough watch patrol time.
